EVALUATION WORKSPACE

Run real agents on a website.

Fresh Muse Spark browser agents do real customer tasks on two versions of a website. Every answer is checked against the site’s own records, and the report shows where agents got stuck and what to change.

This live evaluation gives 3 customer tasks (the same for every version; see them) to browser agents on both versions of the college’s website: Before (the redesigned site) and After (the same site with Agent Readiness’s recommendations applied), three agents on each. Both websites are frozen copies of the fictional Larkspur Community College, run with the same tasks, agent and limits.
